scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,agent -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @remote-desk/api" "npm run dev -w @remote-desk/web" "npm run dev -w @remote-desk/agent"
scripts.dev:server: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @remote-desk/api" "npm run dev -w @remote-desk/web"
